SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.PRODUCT_ID, R.USER_ID, R.RATING, R.COMMENT, U.USERNAME FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS R INNER JOIN USERS U ON R.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE R.PRODUCT_ID = #productId#
R.RATING >= #minRating#
ORDER BY R.REVIEW_ID DESC
SELECT PRODUCT_ID, AVG(RATING) AS AVG_RATING, COUNT(*) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #productId# GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID
SELECT REVIEW_ID, PRODUCT_ID, USER_ID, RATING, COMMENT FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS WHERE USER_ID = #userId#
SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.PRODUCT_ID, R.USER_ID, R.RATING, R.COMMENT, U.USERNAME FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS R INNER JOIN USERS U ON R.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE R.RATING <= 2 ORDER BY R.REVIEW_ID DESC
